_doc: Revert-verify mutants for ticket 035da1eb (RFC 9821a379 AC3): `assembleLayoutBlocks` inverts block → Layout links — order ASC, unordered after numbered, ties by uid ASC, a block of another Layout does not get in, an ambiguous link attaches to none, a Layout no block names is dropped.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/domain/layout/assembleLayoutBlocks.ts

N1_order_ignored_between_numbered._note: Two numbered blocks compare equal regardless of order — falls to the input order of the stable sort.

N2_unordered_first._note: Blocks without an order go BEFORE the numbered ones. A11 too: its odd-order block is unordered.
N2_unordered_first.from:
if (a.order !== null && b.order === null) return -1;
  if (a.order === null && b.order !== null) return 1;
N2_unordered_first.to:
if (a.order !== null && b.order === null) return 1;
  if (a.order === null && b.order !== null) return -1;

N3_tie_by_uid_desc._note: Ties and the unordered tail by uid DESC.
N3_tie_by_uid_desc.from:
if (a.uid < b.uid) return -1;
  if (a.uid > b.uid) return 1;
N3_tie_by_uid_desc.to:
if (a.uid < b.uid) return 1;
  if (a.uid > b.uid) return -1;

N4_block_joins_wrong_layout._note: Every linked block joins the FIRST Layout — the negative clause «блок другого Layout не попадает». A9 too: own-b of L2 would join L1.

N5_layout_without_blocks_kept._note: A Layout no block names is kept with an empty block list — «Layout без блоков не выбирается» lost.
N5_layout_without_blocks_kept.to:
`Layout ${layout.uid}: no exo__LayoutBlock names this Layout through exo__LayoutBlock_layout — the Layout is not selected (exo__Layout_blocks is no longer read) (${layout.sourcePath})`,
      );

N6_ambiguous_guessed._note: A reference naming two Layouts is attached to the first instead of none.

N7_label_not_indexed._note: Layouts are not indexed by label — `[[label]]` references fail; the shared-label case then reads «names no known Layout» instead of «names 2 Layouts».

N8_basename_not_indexed._note: Layouts are not indexed by file basename — `[[<file name>]]` references fail (only A5's b4 uses a basename that differs from the uid).
